g.text: Left: 55 fixed-point tones at bin centers/midpoints and band edges, direction (13.5°, 1.5°). Each reference uses the same geometry/grid and all 27 bins.
This sampled sweep is not a continuous-band worst-case guarantee. Right: quantized Q16 coefficients. A notch also removes wanted signals at that frequency.
